items.q: We worked, when Illinois Jacquet left Lionel Hampton...

ctx.x: Well, it has been said by, you know, different observers and also maybe through things that Bud said, that one of his inspirations and models was Billy Kyle.
I wouldn't doubt that. We worked, when Illinois Jacquet left Lionel Hampton in the height of -- what was the name of it? that? "Flying Home."
